newsitem.title: USA: ROC Communities holders ok Chateau merger. [CORRECTED 23:58 GMT]
newsitem.headline: ROC Communities holders ok Chateau merger. [CORRECTED 23:58 GMT]

text.p: ROC Communities Inc said on Tuesday its shareholders approved a merger with Chateau Properties Inc, a step in forming the largest mobile home park operator in the United States. (Corrects to clarify that merger is not yet complete)

Chateau Properties was the target of a $26 a share takeover by Manufactured Home Communities Inc, which was previously the largest company in the industry, but Chateau Properties and ROC continued with their deal.
More than 93 percent of the shares voting at the meeting approved the deal between ROC and Chateau, ROC said.
